episodes.156766: A front lifted north from central FL during the afternoon as a mid level impulse passed overhead. These features combined with diurnal instability produced a few strong to marginally severe storms.
episodes.157008: An isolated thunderstorm briefly became severe and produced minor wind damage within a small area of Fruitland Park.

events.narrative: Storm total rainfall was 3.40 inches for the day in NW Palm Coast.

A trained weather spotter reported that wind downed thick trees and that shingle and soffit damage occurred to several homes near Ulrick Street in Fruitland Acres. Photographs were also received of roof damage to a nearby church. The wind damage likely resulted from a microburst.
